terrainDescription.zh: 薩赫爾半乾燥草原與大西洋沿岸，達卡半島為主要都會區
terrainDescription.en: Sahelian semi-arid savanna and Atlantic coastline, with the Dakar peninsula as the main urban hub

plate.color: black text on white with a blue "SN"+flag country strip on the left; format "AA-123-BC" (2019–present)

roadInfra.bollardStyle: Not independently confirmed for Senegal; French colonial road-infrastructure legacy suggests it likely resembles other Francophone-West-Africa/French-style concrete bollards, but treat as low-confidence

utilityPole.transformerMount: "Ladder-style" poles reported as similar to those used in parts of metropolitan France

historicalContext.zh: 法語系西非國家，殖民歷史使法語成為行政/教育語言，但日常口語以沃洛夫語為主。
historicalContext.en: A Francophone West African country — French is the administrative/education language, while Wolof dominates everyday speech.

note.zh: 寬鬆長袍 Boubou／Grand Boubou 在達卡街頭常見，但廣泛見於整個法語系西非（馬利、幾內亞等），不能單獨鎖定塞內加爾；法文＋沃洛夫語混用的招牌拼字反而更可靠。
note.en: The flowing Boubou/Grand Boubou robe is common on Dakar streets, but widespread across Francophone West Africa — not diagnostic alone. French+Wolof mixed signage spelling is a more reliable clue.

culturalMarkers.caveat: Pan-regional — do not treat as country-diagnostic on its own
